name: Flow Rate Calculator
description: Calculate volumetric flow rate from pipe diameter and velocity, with unit conversions.

seo.title: Flow Rate Calculator - Pipe Flow
seo.description: Calculate volumetric flow rate Q from pipe diameter and fluid velocity. Supports m³/h, L/min, GPM.

formula.explanation: Q = A × v = π(D/2)² × v. Diameter in m, velocity in m/s; ×3600 converts m³/s to m³/h.

content.introduction: Calculate the volumetric flow rate through a pipe given its diameter and the fluid velocity. This is the fundamental Q = A × v relationship used in all fluid mechanics.

faq.q: How do I convert to GPM?
faq.a: 1 m³/h = 4.403 GPM. Multiply the result by 4.403 for US gallons per minute.

faq.q: What is typical flow for a 4-inch pipe?
faq.a: A 4-inch (100mm) pipe at 2 m/s carries about 56 m³/h or 247 GPM.
